ITEM.PTXT: In conventional automatic transaxles, downshifts from 6th to 3th and from 5th to 2nd pass through intermediate gears, with emphasis on continuity of driving force during the shift. In addition to this, the U660E has adopted direct downshift control, which does not pass through intermediate gears, for downshifts from 6th to 3th and from 5th to 2nd.

As a result, when the accelerator pedal is depressed quickly, a direct downshift without passing through intermediate gears is performed with emphasis on the time to reach the target gear, and when the accelerator pedal is depressed slowly, a downshift through intermediate gears is performed with emphasis on smooth continuity of driving force, achieving downshift response that matches the driver's intentions.
